body:
| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51634284/369916977/-2123748265?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220929eoq7_jtm_odpf90ds_SLA_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTY5ODI1YS01NjQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oU23xcgNgDVppJygc9uKfvf7F3emgr46CtkFSIHScYM=)
---
Hello there, this is Wes’ mom, Joy. As you know, my son is running for Governor of Maryland, and he has worked so incredibly hard to get to this point, changing lives for the better along the way. Growing up, Wes could be a handful at times but I always knew he had a big heart. We faced challenges as a family after losing my husband so suddenly when Wes was only three, but I always pressed him on the importance of a good education, and eventually sent him to military school to set him on a positive path in life. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51634285/369916978/-2123748265?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220929eoq7_jtm_odpf90ds_SLA_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTY5ODI1YS01NjQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oU23xcgNgDVppJygc9uKfvf7F3emgr46CtkFSIHScYM=)

We’re not on track to hit the number I have in my budget right now. We came up short of our projection last week.
#

How we do ahead of tomorrow’s FEC deadline has enormous implications for North Carolina’s Senate race and Democrats’ chance of expanding the majority.
After this deadline, we will sit down to look at the numbers and make some of the most important spending decisions of the entire race. Our budget for the final month will determine which investments we can make.
So I’ll be blunt: We’re not on track to hit the number I have in my budget right now. We came up short of our projection last week, and now we have been working overtime to make up that ground AND hit this week’s even bigger goal.
That’s no reason to panic. We still have time to get there, but we have to all come together to make these next 24 hours the best fundraising day our campaign has ever had.
[**Please make a $3 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat before tomorrow’s FEC deadline. Do it today to make sure Cheri doesn’t fall short of this goal.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220929-5-MA&t=1&akid=1884%2E357359%2Er4arkU)
With a new poll this week showing us tied with Ted Budd at 46%, every dollar absolutely makes a difference.
That’s why we approach every decision on this campaign with the mindset that the final margin will be as close as Cheri’s race for Chief Justice in 2020 — 401 votes.
So far, our strategy is working. DC pundits are stunned by how competitive this race is, and we’re within striking distance of a historic victory. So my hope is that we don’t have to scale anything back when we need to be ramping up.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We built this movement from the ground up because we truly believe in
people power. Everything we do is based on our belief that our communities
can overcome the odds and elect representatives who will actually fight
for them.

Leaders like Cori Bush, Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar,
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Jamaal Bowman. It’s for that same reason
that our electoral and organizing work is funded by regular folks like
you.

Today, we’re hoping you’ll be one of those people, and help us close the
gap between the $112,500 we’ve raised and our $125,000 end-of-quarter
goal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116353?refcode=em20220929-25347&t=1002&akid=25347%2E1203867%2EOgp_dK ]These resources will help us re-elect AND expand the Squad. We’re so
close now to reaching our goal, so can we count on your contribution of
$3?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116353?refcode=em20220929-25347&t=1003&akid=25347%2E1203867%2EOgp_dK ][IMG]

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116353?refcode=em20220929-25347&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25347%2E1203867%2EOgp_dK ]Contribute

We all know how important it is that the Squad continues to grow – that’s
why we’re in this work for the long run. But there’s no doubt that this
election in November is particularly critical, and we want to send all of
our Justice Democrats to Congress to join the Squad.

We know it can be a lot to ask, but one donation of $3 goes
a long way when thousands of grassroots donors all over the country chip
in. People like you power our work and allow us to achieve what some may
think is impossible, like electing Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and AOC.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116353?refcode=em20220929-25347&t=1023&akid=25347%2E1203867%2EOgp_dK ]We’re getting so close to our $125,000 goal for the quarter, and just
one donation of $3 will make a difference to us. Can we
count on your support?

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1024&akid=25347%2E1203867%2EOgp_dK ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Peter, I wanted to take a moment to personally say thank you.

Thank you for dreaming of a better Senate with me – one that works for the _people_ , not just for the corporate elites.

Thank you for fighting by my side every step of the way in this race – through all the victories and setbacks.

---
Peter,

Time is flying by and we're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; **if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district.** If we don't, it's sayonara. No investment, nothing. I'll be on my own.

Today marks 40 days until Election Day and 1 days until the end of the 3rd quarter, meaning that as of this writing, **[I've only 1 days to meet their goal, or it's sayonara.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)** In case you missed it, I'm forwarding my original message from last week.

**[I'd be so appreciative if you were able to gift my campaign a couple dollars to help us reach this make-or-break fundraising goal](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)**.

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)
---

\-----Forwarded message-----
From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if**I**** can't, I'll be on my own till the end. ************

With only 14 days to go, we're still short about $60,000. **[If you're in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)**

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)
---

Whether it's a test or not - I'm not taking any chances. While Oregon's 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it's ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you're on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r) **

My opponent this year is a the protege of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I'd like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker's gavel next Congress? Less than 10.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61449784:Jo1KfnVlN:m:1:3317145305:558AC60EAFA57E98A65033C410C8DE88:r)
---

Thanks for your consideration, Peter

In service,

Alek Skarlatos

body:
And we're defending him in court!
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | Friend, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-oH53svaDHbGLvqaIA) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...**_and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._R3zzHvlxumw0hdP7_w)** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-4cb9vrJqoEqtXKkNRw)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,
---

---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel

They'd love to see Mark rotting away in federal prison for his selfless devotion to the unborn, using his defense of his young son as the excuse. You and I cannot let that happen. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone. Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood want to destroy pro-life, father-of-seven Mark Houck and intimidate people of faith everywhere. They'd love to see Mark rotting away in federal prison for his selfless devotion to the unborn, using his defense of his young son as the excuse. You and I cannot let that happen. | | | © Thomas More Society | 309 W. name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: We Demand Secure Elections
body:
Election integrity is an important aspect of a free society. Voting and choosing who will represent us in government is a duty that every citizen must exercise. The key wor
|
---
| | | | Election integrity is an important aspect of a free society. Voting and choosing who will represent us in government is a duty that every citizen must exercise. The key word in that sentence is “citizen”. A nation can not remain free, nor can we truly have a representative government if the representatives are selected by someone other than those being governed.We must have faith in our election system for our government to work properly.One important way to ensure our elections are held with integrity is by requiring proof that the person casting the ballot is indeed who they claim to be. Mississippi has been a leader in this area for more than a decade. In 2011, a citizen-initiated Constitutional Amendment was approved that requires eligible voters to present a photo ID before casting a ballot. This applies both at the polls on election day or in the Circuit Clerk's office if voting absentee.According to Secretary of State Michael Watson, more than 99.97% of all voters provided a photo ID when casting their ballot in the last election.[We Demand Secure Elections - Sign petition](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/8SyBGlegBsFaEC8P588XPw)The Secretary of State lists on his website the acceptable forms of ID:
* A driver’s license
* A photo ID issued by a branch, department or entity of the State of Mississippi
* A United States passport
* A government employee ID card
* A firearms license
* A student photo ID issued by an accredited Mississippi university, college or community/junior college
* A United States military ID
* A tribal photo ID
* Any other photo ID issued by any branch, department, agency or entity of the United States __ government or any state government
* A Mississippi Voter Identification Card

There are three exemptions that allow a voter to cast a ballot without a photo ID, including religious objections to being photographed and military personnel casting ballots from overseas. Voter ID is one of the best ways to cut down on election fraud, but there is still more to be done in Mississippi to secure the integrity of our elections. The next important steps that Mississippi must take is
* Cleaning our voter rolls
* Putting greater restrictions on mail-in ballots to cut down on the opportunity for fraud.

[SIGN PETITION](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/8SyBGlegBsFaEC8P588XPw) and demand your Representative and Senator ensure our elections are secure!

Fellow Conservative:

The surge is on.
The media is trying to hide it. The Left is trying to ignore it. But poll after poll now shows a red wave is swelling across the country. It's our job to make sure it crashes down on the Washington establishment in November!
But it's not just any Republican - our conservative Senate candidates are leading this surge into the fall elections.
▶︎ In Georgia, Herschel Walker has taken the lead against woke incumbent Sen. Raphael Warnock.
▶︎ In Wisconsin, Sen. Ron Johnson has pulled ahead of liberal challenger Mandela Barnes.
▶︎ In Utah, Sen. Mike Lee has exposed woke pretender Evan McMullin and opened up a double-digit lead!
▶︎ In North Carolina, conservative Congressman Ted Budd is ahead of liberal Cheri Beasley.
▶︎ In Nevada, SCF candidate Adam Laxalt now leads incumbent liberal Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto.
▶︎ And in Missouri, state Attorney General Eric Schmitt is leaving Democrat Trudy Valentine in the dust.
This looks like good news. It is good news. But it's also a warning. The Left will not sit back and let the country throw them out of office. You and I know what happens when liberals get desperate.
Phony scandals will emerge. Polls will start to skew. October surprises will explode with Big Tech and Big Media all-in for the woke, socialist Left. And, of course, woke election officials will get to work behind the scenes, too.
Help us fight the Left's October surprises with an even bigger surge today!
Until all the votes are counted on Election Night, good news for conservative candidates only means more work for conservative citizens. We have to volunteer for more weekends, knock on more doors, observe more polling places, and give as much of our labor, prayers, and
resources as possible.
Increase the surge. Support our Senate candidates now!
This is the year Americans start to take back our country. And step one is taking back the Senate with true conservatives who will stand up to the liberals in BOTH parties!
Our candidates are the most principled, the most outspoken, and the most courageous. But it's up to all of us to make them the most successful.
Please donate $25, $50, $100, or more to these outstanding candidates today.
SCF has made it so you can donate directly to their campaigns with one online transaction. SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contributions to their campaigns. Thank you for considering this urgent request and for supporting the candidates who will

September 30, 2022
Dear friend,
We are pleased to endorse Ruby Powell-Dennis for State Senate District 31.
Ruby has worked in education, is a community leader, and a mom laser focused on the needs of our children and working people. Ruby grew up in the rural community of Bogalusa, Louisiana, which shapes her commitment to and unique perspective on the needs of all Tennesseans.
Ruby has a long history of serving Shelby County through New Memphis and the Junior League of Memphis. She's also worked hard to elect progressive women all over the country through her PAC, Elect Black Women [https://www.electblackwomenpac.com/] .
JOIN TVP IN SUPPORT OF RUBY POWELL-DENNIS FOR STATE SENATE DISTRICT 31 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpforrpd]
Ruby is running to expand affordable healthcare for people in need, equitable education funding, and increasing investment in small businesses. Ruby stands ready to challenge the status quo in Tennessee of legislation that harms working families, women, and kids. We need more folks like Ruby and, frankly, more moms who will boldly advocate for all Tennesseans.
Click this link to support Ruby Powell-Dennis for State Senate District 31 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpforrpd] . Half of what you contribute will go directly to Ruby's campaign [https://www.rubypowelldennis.com/] and the other half will go to turning out voters in November. More about the work we're doing to turn out voters in West Tennessee coming soon.
Thank you for your support,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: Mandela Barnes is one point behind Ron Johnson in the latest Marquette poll. Can you contribute to his campaign to help him flip Wisconsin's Senate seat?
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Let me be very clear:
Ron Johnson is a self-serving multi-millionaire who voted to give huge tax breaks to himself and his billionaire donors. How pathetic is that?
Mandela Barnes can defeat him – but only if we're all in this together.
The latest Marquette poll shows Mandela trailing Ron Johnson by one point, and Mandela is currently up against millions of dollars in ugly right-wing super PAC ads. Now more than ever, he needs your help to regain the momentum in this race.
So before tonight's FEC fundraising deadline, Mandela is relying on a lot of donations to show there is strong grassroots support for his campaign.
In this time of unprecedented challenges in our country, we need an unprecedented response. We need a movement of people who will fight for justice and stand together against greed, oligarchy, authoritarianism, and bigotry.
Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. He is bringing together a multi-racial, multi-generational movement of people who understand that the billionaire class cannot have it all. At a time of obscene levels of income and wealth inequality, we must address the needs of working families in this country.
As the son of a public school teacher and General Motors worker, Mandela knows the struggles of the working class. And if we can elect him to the Senate, he will take on the billionaire class and large corporations that control a large part of the economy and exert enormous influence over our political system.
But the only way Mandela will run a successful campaign is if lots of people come together and get involved in the Wisconsin Senate race.
While Ron Johnson collects big checks from his special interest donors and corporate PACs, Mandela is counting on lots of people giving small donations before this Friday's FEC deadline.
Your contribution will ensure Mandela has the financial resources to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat. So I am asking you one more time:

It is important that we stand with candidates like Mandela who will have the guts to take on powerful special interests and help create a government that works for ALL of our people, not just the one percent. Thank you for adding your contribution to his campaign for tonight's FEC deadline.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: Pathetic
body:
Derek,
Let me be very clear:
Ron Johnson is a self-serving multi-millionaire who voted to give huge tax breaks to himself and his billionaire donors. How pathetic is that?
Mandela Barnes can defeat him – but only if we're all in this together.
The latest Marquette poll shows Mandela trailing Ron Johnson by one point, and Mandela is currently up against millions of dollars in ugly right-wing super PAC ads. Now more than ever, he needs your help to regain the momentum in this race.
So before Friday's FEC fundraising deadline, Mandela is relying on a lot of donations to show there is strong grassroots support for his campaign. That's why I am asking:
Can you make a $25 contribution split between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood before Friday's FEC fundraising deadline? This is important. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes]
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes]
In this time of unprecedented challenges in our country, we need an unprecedented response. We need a movement of people who will fight for justice and stand together against greed, oligarchy, authoritarianism, and bigotry.
Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. He is bringing together a multi-racial, multi-generational movement of people who understand that the billionaire class cannot have it all. At a time of obscene levels of income and wealth inequality, we must address the needs of working families in this country.
As the son of a public school teacher and General Motors worker, Mandela knows the struggles of the working class. And if we can elect him to the Senate, he will take on the billionaire class and large corporations that control a large part of the economy and exert enormous influence over our political system.
But the only way Mandela will run a successful campaign is if lots of people come together and get involved in the Wisconsin Senate race.
While Ron Johnson collects big checks from his special interest donors and corporate PACs, Mandela is counting on lots of people giving small donations before this Friday's FEC deadline.
Your contribution will ensure Mandela has the financial resources to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat. So I am asking you one more time:
Can you split a $25 contribution between Mandela Barnes and CommonGood before his FEC fundraising deadline ends? Please use this link. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220930_CGVA_Barnes&amount=25]
It is important that we stand with candidates like Mandela who will have the guts to take on powerful special interests and help create a government that works for ALL of our people, not just the one percent.
Thank you for adding your contribution to his campaign for Friday's FEC deadline.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

subject: We can't stand idly by
body:
Republicans are weaponizing public office against climate action. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/349882695a78/we-cant-stand-idly-by?e=5ae73bc006)
---
[](https://tobiasread.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4166b300c2462b3ca6c295f72&id=c45eab7f08&e=5ae73bc006)
#
PeterIt’s that season again. When an election is near it’s easy to find examples of misleading campaign tactics, and this year is no exception.As Treasurer, I’m especially frustrated by the effort by Republicans to weaponize public office against climate action. The New York Times recently published the [results](https://tobiasread.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4166b300c2462b3ca6c295f72&id=0e982f5686&e=5ae73bc006) of a revealing investigation into the strategy and tactics behind this coordinated effort.Here’s the bottom line. Climate change is real, and we need bold and aggressive action against it. And as a fiduciary I am obligated to make investment decisions on behalf of the state, and the hundreds of thousands of beneficiaries of our pension system, based on the best available information about how our investments will fare. That includes climate risk.So I’m not willing to stand idly by in the face of this coordinated effort to deny reality. The New York Times recently published our [guest editorial](https://tobiasread.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4166b300c2462b3ca6c295f72&id=a8ba207701&e=5ae73bc006) and I’d love for you to read it.The theme I tried to surface was our obligation to think about the long run. That’s true as Treasurer, and it’s true as responsible citizens. I want to continue making this case in Oregon and around the country - because the future matters.**I’m aiming to help shape the public discussion on these critical issues and to support candidates who will do the same. Doing that takes resources, and while I’m not on the ballot this year, these ideas, and these threats are.** Can you help us gather the resources we need to stay on offense? **Please make a contribution**[**here**](https://tobiasread.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4166b300c2462b3ca6c295f72&id=d723bb211f&e=5ae73bc006)**and please keep in touch.** Best, Tobias

name: Chrissy
subject: let's finish strong together
body:
Harder to believe, we're approaching our last major FEC deadline before the election.
| | |
---
Derek, I just wanted to touch base for a quick moment:

It's hard to believe, but we're less than six weeks away from Election Day. Harder to believe, we're approaching our _last major FEC deadline before the election_ _._ Every fundraising goal is important to our campaign, but with my opponent and his extremist allies capable of pouring in millions of dollars into this race, this deadline is crucial. That’s why we aim to raise another $25,000 before midnight tonight.
**In order to win this election, I need your support.****Will you chip in $5 to close that gap, hold this battleground seat, and keep our district blue before our midnight end-of-quarter deadline?**

You can donate online here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/houlahan-digital**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51653150/369994833/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk705-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWFmMDRlMy1jODQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HIR5mC9Xw6pqnuOr0douLjX8ml33-5gKnx5gNDLbJDM=)
My opponent has allies with deep pockets. Their dark money and attack ads underscore just how badly they want to flip this seat: to undo all the progress we've made and block future progress we have yet to make.
But let me be clear: We've been here before, and I know we've got the numbers on our side. I know this because ever since you elected me as the first woman ever to represent Pennsylvania's 6th Congressional District, I've had the honor of listening to the needs of families across PA-06 and have had the privilege of fighting for you and delivering on our shared vision for the future. I will continue to prioritize our community's needs in Congress when reelected.
**So let's prove to the GOP that we have the resources to spread our message of progress for working families – over the phones, on television, in mailboxes, and online. From tackling inflation to fighting climate change and protecting reproductive rights, the stakes are too high to let Republicans undo our progress.**
Let's show our opponent and his radical allies that we have the resources to fight back and win on Election Day. By winning this November, we can make sure that our path to progress continues forward.

**Please, Derek, you can have a decisive impact on our election right now. Will you donate $5 before our end-of-quarter FEC deadline tonight, help us close this $25,000 goal, and keep PA-06 blue?**

You can donate online here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/houlahan-digital**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51653151/369994835/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk705-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWFmMDRlMy1jODQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HIR5mC9Xw6pqnuOr0douLjX8ml33-5gKnx5gNDLbJDM=)
Thank you for being a critical part of our movement.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy
| Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
P.O. Box 222
Devon, PA 19333

It's time to make your voting plan ! Only four weeks left to register to vote, and six more weeks until Election Day! Encourage your friends and family to register to vote and check their registration status. When we all vote, we win!
Make my voting plan [bit.ly/NPPVotePA]
NPP In The News
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/5249746C6D35753571455A394C4C3531354D4E55784E6D694D364D615A68323736754E714A7A6F3672436F2F484F72495154725359514D2F63703641736D654F/editor_images/FdLlpJNWAAEBYbT.jpeg]
An Evening with Chris Matthews | Watch Now [https://vimeo.com/752659897]
Veteran political analyst and former host of MSNBC's "Hardball" Chris Matthews shares his views on the upcoming midterm elections followed by leaders of grassroots get-out-the-vote groups in critical target states - Kadida Kenner from the New Pennsylvania Project, Reverend Greg Lewis of Souls to the Polls in Wisconsin and Kate Feldman from You Can Vote in North Carolina.
Pod for the Cause | S6 E02: Why Our Courts Matter | Listen Here [https://civilrights.org/podcast/s06e02/]
On the latest episode of Pod For The Cause, NPP CEO Kadida Kenner and Kim Tignor of She Will Rise join host Kanya Bennett to discuss why courts matter, especially in this moment.
We don’t think so! | The Philadelphia Sun [https://www.philasun.com/local/we-dont-think-so/]
A group of civic and religious leaders came together in support of embattled Philadelphia District Attorney to send a message to Pennsylvania legislators hoping to impeach him: ‘Not on our watch!
West Chester Woman Wants to Make Voting Accessible to All | Vista Today [https://vista.today/2022/09/west-chester-woman-voting-accessible/]
Two months ahead of the midterm election, West Chester native Kadida Kenner, CEO of New Pennsylvania Project, is working hard to ensure voting is accessible to everybody, writes Cherri Gregg for WHYY.
First and vote: Dems to make registration play at PSU, Pitt games | PennLive [https://www.penncapital-star.com/election-2022/first-and-vote-dems-to-make-registration-play-at-psu-pitt-games-friday-morning-coffee/]
Younger voters across central Pennsylvania told PennLive earlier this week that they’re energized and ready to vote. They’re motivated by such issues as education, clean water, and abortion access. “I think right now the biggest hurdle is we are not engaging students in a meaningful way,” Kadida Kenner, of the New Pennsylvania Project, told PennLive.
Mark Your Calendars!
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Election Day! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
News Roundup
Pa. election 2022: A basic guide to vetting candidates for U.S. Senate, governor, and more [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-fetterman-oz-candidates-vetting-guide/] | All eyes will be on Pennsylvania this November election as a number of contentious races on the ballot will determine the state’s political future. While (the Senate and Governor’s) races may be getting the most media attention, Pennsylvanians will also vote for their U.S. House representatives and lawmakers in the state legislature, where Democrats seek to chip away at the Republican majority in both the state House and Senate. It’s vital to thoroughly research the candidates on your ballot, and we’re here to help. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-mastriano-shapiro-fetterman-oz-candidates-vetting-guide/]
Wolf takes lawsuit on constitutional changes to lower court [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-lawsuits-legislature-constitutions-tom-wolf-67090c6ff94204eea683ba7f34e0abd7] [https://www.huffpost.com/entry/doug-mastriano-pennsylvania-gop-governor-candidate-secretary-of-state_n_62e4447fe4b0c60a5668334e?utm_campaign=share_email&ncid=other_email_o63gt2jcad4] | Democratic Gov. Tom Wolf is taking another shot at a lawsuit that argues Republican lawmakers improperly bundled together five proposed state constitutional amendments to get them approved by the Pennsylvania Legislature. (via AP News) [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-lawsuits-legislature-constitutions-tom-wolf-67090c6ff94204eea683ba7f34e0abd7]
Pa. election 2022: There will be no constitutional amendments on the Nov. 8 ballot, but big ones are looming [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-constitutional-amendments-abortion-voter-id/] | Pennsylvania voters will not see any proposed constitutional amendments on this year’s November ballot, but that is almost certain to change when the state legislature opens its new two-year session in January. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-constitutional-amendments-abortion-voter-id/]
Pa. election 2022: How to serve as a poll worker on Nov. 8 [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-poll-worker-guide-how-to-explainer] | When Pennsylvania holds its 2022 general election in November, thousands of poll workers will ensure that voting runs smoothly. You could be one of them. (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-2022-poll-worker-guide-how-to-explainer]
Pa. Republicans are gaining on Democrats in registered voters. We look at what that really means. Peter,

Nine years ago, I filibustered for 13 hours in the Texas State Senate to stop an anti-abortion bill (you probably remember the pink sneakers). It is one of my proudest moments – but what happened that day isn't really about me. It is about the people who showed up to the Texas Capitol to join me: Their voices, their organizing, and their stomping feet ultimately stopped the vote on that anti-abortion bill. Not me – _us. _

That grassroots power is what I'm asking you to channel into electing Trudy Busch Valentine to the U.S. Senate (**[you can make a donation here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51660405/370021281/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk350-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYTBiYTE0Mi1kMTQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xch3PfQpDKGSRXv9u0DkKp5MchuIV5w0mt_dFQl41_4=)**), because abortion access is under attack in America – and _we_ must __ fight back. Allow me just a moment to explain:
Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, far-right state legislators all over the country are passing increasingly extreme abortion bans – including in Trudy's home state of Missouri, and my home state of Texas. Meanwhile, the GOP's henchmen in the Senate are doing all that they can to pass a nationwide ban on abortion.
Every single American deserves the freedom to choose what happens to their own bodies – especially when that choice impacts our health, the jobs we have, the education we can attain, and the life we lead. **But instead, with their latest legislation, people like Eric Schmitt and Greg Abbott are making that decision for us.**
It's impossible to put into words the grief, pain, and anger that I feel watching these extremists turn back the clock on our hard-fought reproductive freedom. **But this fight isn't over until we say it is – and I don't know about you, but _ I'm not giving up. _**
That's why I'm emailing you today: **Trudy is the leader that Missouri needs right now. She's a nurse, a mom, and a fierce advocate for our reproductive rights.** In the Senate, she will proudly be one of the critical votes we need to finally codify abortion access. But first, she has to win in November.
**Trudy and I both know that we can't sit this one out – and we need you not to sit it out either. clean_body: | | | Peter, Nine years ago, I filibustered for 13 hours in the Texas State Senate to stop an anti-abortion bill (you probably remember the pink sneakers). It is one of my proudest moments – but what happened that day isn't really about me. It is about the people who showed up to the Texas Capitol to join me: Their voices, their organizing, and their stomping feet ultimately stopped the vote on that anti-abortion bill. Not me – us. That grassroots power is what I'm asking you to channel into electing Trudy Busch Valentine to the U.S. Senate (=), because abortion access is under attack in America – and we must fight back. Allow me just a moment to explain: Now that the Supreme Court has overturned Roe v. Wade, far-right state legislators all over the country are passing increasingly extreme abortion bans – including in Trudy's home state of Missouri, and my home state of Texas. Meanwhile, the GOP's henchmen in the Senate are doing all that they can to pass a nationwide ban on abortion. Every single American deserves the freedom to choose what happens to their own bodies – especially when that choice impacts our health, the jobs we have, the education we can attain, and the life we lead. But instead, with their latest legislation, people like Eric Schmitt and Greg Abbott are making that decision for us. It's impossible to put into words the grief, pain, and anger that I feel watching these extremists turn back the clock on our hard-fought reproductive freedom. But this fight isn't over until we say it is – and I don't know about you, but I'm not giving up. That's why I'm emailing you today: Trudy is the leader that Missouri needs right now. She's a nurse, a mom, and a fierce advocate for our reproductive rights. In the Senate, she will proudly be one of the critical votes we need to finally codify abortion access. But first, she has to win in November. #### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, you have choices in this year's U.S. Senate race, and I'm proud to be one of them! Just take a look at the sample paper ballot below. The electronic version should be similar. It's easy and you can still choose your party! On November 8th, get ready to write my initials or an abbreviation: H.K., OR Haneefah, Khaaliq, or Haneefah Khaaliq. View detailed instructions [here](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=6eb8936999&e=a49cb82bb3) or scroll down. See you at the polls!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Share this message with nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=a112235eed&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=448a88a1ec&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=6d736dcfa2&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate

body:
I lost my primary

Peter,

The first time I ran for office I lost my primary, but as a product of the American dream I don't believe in giving up.

My name is Catalina, and I'm the America First Hispanic woman running for Congress in the what is now the _**CLOSEST RACE IN AMERICA-**_ the one race that will define Nancy Pelosi's legacy.

This is my first time reaching out to you, and I'm afraid of what happens if this email doesn't work.

**But I'm not afraid to tell you that I am a Christian who is Pro-Life, Pro-Family, and Pro-Law Enforcement.**

Democrats and their partners in the liberal media will tell you that someone of my ethnicity and my age can't be any of those things. They assume that I'm just a Hispanic millennial who won't challenge them on their lack of principles, platform, and patriotism.

And they're spending millions to shut me up because they know they can't take another humiliating loss from within the Hispanic community. But I refuse to be muzzled & I'll **_never_** back down from challenging the radical left on their divisive, Anti-American bullshit.

_**I will always stand up to defend our Christian conservative values, and our way of life. I will always stand up for what is right. **_

I'm not a career politician with a rolodex of corporate mega-donors. As a conservative, I'll admit that I struggle asking others for help, but I know that I have to because this race is about so much more than me.

So I'm asking you to chip in just a few bucks today to help my campaign move forward, united against the radical left and their liberal agenda. **We're so close to flipping this seat & with your help, I know we will!** ******[**CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61451990:61MRkBVHN:m:1:3253819041:B4AB68307E0D53A3AF0EDDC7E9BED027:r)****** If I can ever help you the way you've helped me, **_please_** just say the word.

God Bless America,

Catalina

Candidate for U.S Congress

# **South Bay CRA News**
Our church is planning our yearly Christmas outreach. Every year we surprise a lower-income area on Christmas eve we go door to door giving gifts to kids.
It's an absolutely amazing feeling to see the looks on the kid's faces and the tears in the parent's eyes. Last year I believe we did over 100 doors.
This year we are planning a pop-up block party in a housing project. The families don't know we are coming with bikes, presents, a DJ, haircuts, hot chocolate, Santa, hotdogs, and more.
If you or your organization would like to participate please let me know. We are taking tax-deductible cash and monetary donations now. You can give them at the links below.
Give to the Christmas outreach:
Paypal: www.paypal.me/derrickgates
Cashapp: $derrickgatesmin
Venmo: @Derrick-Gates-4
Blessed and Free
**Nena Gates**
President
nenarenae2@gmail.com

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW16AbMheN

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW16AbMheN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits.
#

Friends -
11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there in my head. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
**Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. But in the fight to make our communities safer from gun violence, it is our collective voices that speak loudest.
That’s why tonight’s fundraising deadline is so important. Shortly after it ends, the number of donations we received in September will be public.
And my hope is that this number will communicate to elected officials, and our opponents in the gun lobby, that our movement to make our communities safer from gun violence is as large and passionate as ever.
So I am asking:
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution to Giffords PAC before tonight’s campaign finance deadline ends? The amount of your donation is not nearly as important as the donation itself. So please. Help send a powerful message about the strength of our movement.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sept22.KOv07R&refcode=em220930-1-30&t=1&akid=2548%2E3935704%2EAvX0D7)

body:
What if I told you...
#

Friend —
I’m writing to ask if there’s ANYTHING I can say to convince you to make a contribution before our last FEC fundraising deadline of the campaign at midnight tonight.
What if I told you that my opponent is a GOP extremist who supports a dangerous national abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest?

Peter,
Doug Mastriano never fails to disappoint.
With under 40 days to go until Election Day, Doug Mastriano is doubling down on his dangerous plan to ban abortion — and wants to charge women who have them with murder.
But you don’t have to take our word for it. Just read the interview for yourself.
Interviewer : Would that woman who decided have an abortion, which would be considered an illegal abortion, be charged with murder?
Mastriano : Okay, let's go back to the basic question there. Is that a human being? Is that a little boy or girl? If it is, it deserves equal protection in the law.
Interviewer : So you're saying yes?
Mastriano : Yes, I am.
Just take a minute and let that sink in.
Doug Mastriano wants to charge women who have an abortion with murder.
He’s also vowed to ban abortion with no exceptions — not for rape, incest, or life of the mother. Not only is this position dangerous and extreme, but it’s also widely unpopular. A CBS News survey from this month found that 93% of Pennsylvania voters want abortion to remain legal.
But if Doug Mastriano is elected on November 8, this is the future Pennsylvanians have to look forward to.

subject: re: our big deadline at 11:59 p.m.

body:
| Hiiii,

I'm coming to you today to ask if you'll please split a [**donation between my campaign to flip PA 's U.S Senate seat + Voter Protection Project before the FEC deadline today at 11:59 p.m. ET.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28028?t=6&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)

That said, I think we owe you an explanation. Some context, if you will.

Every quarter, campaigns like ours are legally required to report out all our latest fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission. **Basically, it 's a public test of the grassroots strength of our campaign.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28028?t=7&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh) So, as you might expect, reporters will be scouring these numbers -- as will Dr. Oz and everybody on his side. Especially because this is our *last* quarterly deadline before Election Day.

TL: DR; putting up a huge number today is a really, _really_ big deal. So (drumroll please...) **we 're setting a goal of $10 million dollars!!!**

[**We've got a helluva ways to go to get there, so I am humbly asking you to please split a donation between my campaign + Voter Protection Project before tonight's deadline to help reach our major end-of-quarter goal.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28028?t=8&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between John Fetterman and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28029?t=9&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28030?t=10&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28031?t=11&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28032?t=12&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28028?t=13&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
Look, it's not lost on me that you get a lot of requests from me + my team.

I know they can sometimes start to pile up.

But the reality is that, if we want to win the #1 Most Likely to Flip Senate seat of 2022 on grassroots power alone, then we MUST raise as much money as possible before our *last* FEC deadline at midnight.
**The only way we can win is with lots of online donations -- big or small -- from people like you.** [**So I've gotta ask: Will you donate split a donation of any amount between my campaign + Voter Protection Project ahead of tonight's FEC deadline? It'd really make all the difference as we push ahead toward November.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28028?t=14&akid=4753%2E878179%2EgTCnhh)
Thank you for everything. I'll reach back out soon.

❤️John

subject: I'm desperate for your help
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alek for Oregon
body:
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)
---
Peter,

Time is flying by and we're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; **if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district.** If we don't, it's sayonara. No investment, nothing. I'll be on my own.

Today marks 40 days until Election Day and 1 days until the end of the 3rd quarter, meaning that as of this writing, **[I've only 1 days to meet their goal, or it's sayonara.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)** In case you missed it, I'm forwarding my original message from last week.

**[I'd be so appreciative if you were able to gift my campaign a couple dollars to help us reach this make-or-break fundraising goal](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)**.

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)
---

\-----Forwarded message-----
From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if**I**** can't, I'll be on my own till the end. ************

With only 14 days to go, we're still short about $60,000. **[If you're in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)**

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)
---

Whether it's a test or not - I'm not taking any chances. While Oregon's 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it's ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you're on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r) **

My opponent this year is a the protege of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I'd like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker's gavel next Congress? Less than 10.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453382:6lo61BVNX:m:1:3331421248:1E424D076C683F5DED3C6BA92C2D436F:r)
---

Thanks for your consideration, Peter

In service,

Big news, Peter.

**_The Los Angeles Times_ Editorial Board just endorsed Will Rollins' campaign to flip the 41st District!**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51679459/370086315/192312732?refcode=em-9.30.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzcwOTlkMS1lZjQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Xxm93xfUUMw3JfD2a8LaBaFPT5yJDM46Cee7HAX7E08=)

| | We are under 40 days until Election Day! We need your help directly contacting voters. Can you help?

The most important need we have is making calls. You can either join us at one of our upcoming phone banks or we can set you up to make calls from home. See the details below!

_**PHONE BANKING**_

We've got a phone banking opportunity TOMORROW. _Will you join us?_

Make sure to bring your own device. You can bring a laptop, iPad, tablet or smart phone. Also, headphones will really help. To schedule a shift, fill out the form below with all the times you are available.

_**WHERE:**_

Minnetonka, MN 55345

_**CALLING FROM HOME**_

We have an incredible system that allows for people to make calls from home. I know that not everyone lives close enough to our phone banking location or are available during the scheduled shifts. subject: 2.5% Flat Tax Going Into Effect Early
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ducey for Governor
body:
Ducey announces that Arizona has passed the economic threshold needed to implement the 2.5% flat tax one year ahead of schedule | |
---
| | |
---
| | | Hello,

Good news for Arizona taxpayers: the 2.5% flat income tax is being phased in one year ahead of schedule!

Thanks to robust economic growth, general fund revenue has passed the threshold needed for early implementation of the tax cut. Governor Ducey notified the Department of Revenue that implementation of the lowest flat tax in the nation can begin in 2023.
---
|
---
|
# Arizona hits revenue threshold to implement 2.5% flat income tax a year early

Sept. 29, 2022
BY [KEVIN STONE](https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=4f7fc7edb9&e=55d4e2f84a) PHOENIX – Arizona’s flat income tax rate of 2.5% will kick in for the 2023 tax year thanks to a healthy economy, the state announced Thursday. The single-rate system was scheduled to be implemented no later than the 2024 tax year, but it will start a year earlier because the state’s general fund revenue surpassed a statutory threshold. The phased-in flat tax plan was part of the [2021 state budget](https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=49aa72a4e0&e=55d4e2f84a). The plan will cut income taxes by 13% for the average taxpayer, about $340 per year, [according to the Governor’s Office](https://dougducey.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf4fbf102e325035a83ef3427&id=7fb24e4b21&e=55d4e2f84a).

| | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you. I believe I am the best candidate for Wisconsin because I tell the truth and speak for the minority, even when the majority is doing everything they can to silence me.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. The Democrats even placed a $2M ad buy just moments after I announced my campaign for re-election.

And that's why I need your help.

_**[Any help you can provide will make an enormous difference and will be greatly appreciated. $25, $50, $100, or even $250 will help me respond to these hit pieces and smear campaigns. It will take all of us working together to defeat the Left and their dishonest tactics.

Can I count on you to chip in? We need to start working right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61453334:JEPKmBVNj:m:1:3253819041:73AD4BE2429C0C2E7943C434AE1867ED:r "Any help you can provide will make an

Ron Johnson

---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76931%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ro1fSc3t6de69EfHwnSkBg&sysid=1)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76932%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P059hLmCVJQnunqTTGwPCg&sysid=1)_ _**
---

I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76934%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yNJZ949hQbuEzq5Xb5m2Kw&sysid=1)

Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76945%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O%2f528VULYRFIS1Gh3mtXtw&sysid=1)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76946%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=q%2bT%2bML4FNLtwGslYIMRbcw&sysid=1)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay. ** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track. ** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona! ** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It’s game time. ** ** And I need you on my side. ** ** **_[Will you support our momentum?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76947%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SPN3KOVuGqY8HqArt12F4Q&sysid=1)___**
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76948%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=b6kcQvXbA6slaolhjG2EEw&sysid=1)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: I’m personally asking for your support
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
They weren’t prepared for us to run a new kind of campaign, and we are giving them the fight of their life.
#

I wanted to send you a quick note before the day got away from us to ask for your support.
We’re throwing out the old playbook here. We have seen it fail us too many times in North Carolina, so victory this November hinges on running a new kind of campaign for our state.
Republicans are rallying around my opponent because they’ve seen the same polls that we have. They see this race is in a dead heat, and they’re panicked. Truthfully, they thought North Carolina was a slam dunk. They weren’t prepared for us to run a new kind of campaign, and we are giving them the fight of their life.
But it’s our job to make sure we don’t slow down for even a moment in this final sprint to Election Day.
[**That’s why I’m personally asking you to contribute before tonight’s FEC deadline. Your donation today could be the reason we flip this seat and expand our majority in November.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220930-2-MA&t=1&akid=1903%2E357359%2EXAO20L)
One of the most important things I’ve learned running (and winning) statewide in North Carolina is it comes down to the margins. That was true when I won in 2014, and it was true in 2020 when 401 votes out of over 5 million decided my race for Chief Justice.
So we need to make sure we have the resources to fight for every vote in all 100 counties. Nobody gets left behind or forgotten, rural and urban, from the mountains to the coast. That is what you deserve from your United States Senator.
We will give a voice to everybody who shares our belief that a future where every single one of us has the chance to thrive is possible — if we fight for it.
And look, I don’t expect people to give every time we ask. But my hope is you take this request as an indication of just how important your support is. What we are counting on is that folks like you will donate when it makes sense for your budget.
[**So if you are able to make a contribution before tonight’s deadline, it would mean a lot to me personally. We’re coming up short of our goal right now, so every donation counts.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220930-2-MA&t=2&akid=1903%2E357359%2EXAO20L)

clean_body: | Friend, I know we email you a lot asking for you to make a contribution to support the Indiana Democratic Party and to invest in our efforts to deliver a brighter future for Hoosier families, workers, students, and seniors. Sometimes it can be hard to understand the value that even just a single dollar can bring to the work Democrats are doing in Indiana. While our politics can seem so negative each day, I firmly believe that we have brighter days ahead, and it’s because Democrats are working to solve the everyday issues most important to Hoosiers – no matter where they live or work. From creating good-paying jobs, expanding broadband, lowering prescription drug costs, repealing the diaper tax, expanding health care for veterans, implementing new gun safety measures, and making the largest investment to fight climate change in our nation’s history, Democrats are delivering a better future for Indiana – and we’re not stopping anytime soon. This is why the INDEMS, with your constant support, has crisscrossed the state - nine times \- because we know Democrats’ biggest strength is when we meet voters where they are, not where we want them to be. We’ve held more than 140 events in 66 counties because Democrats want to hear about the issues most important to all voters everywhere. We’ve got a real shot at electing a great slate of experienced – and new – Hoosier Democrats who are ready to answer the call and reverse the harm done by Republicans’ extremist agenda, but we can’t do it without your support. = Whether it’s $1 or $100, your support before this final deadline will play a critical role in the outcome of this election. | | | Hi friend -- It's Martin Sheen.

While I may have played a fictional president on TV, I’ve spent my life outside of acting devoted to political activism. That’s why I’m reaching out to you now -- because frankly, **I’m concerned about what’s at stake in the fight for the Senate.**

Democrats hold a 50-50 Senate majority, so if Republicans win even one seat, they could flip the Senate and hand power back to Mitch McConnell.

**[Saving the Senate has never been more critical. So I’m personally asking, will you join me in protecting and expanding our Democratic majority by chipping in $5 to the DSCC today?](https://go.dscc.org/go/8670?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220930-MartinSheen-SheenSigned1-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220930-MartinSheen-SheenSigned1-Pros-sl1&akid=7213%2E9716520%2EVQzDvu)**

In one of the most important midterm elections of our lifetimes, we can’t leave anything to chance. Everything from voting rights and climate action to commonsense gun reform and more is on the ballot in just a few weeks.

But Senate Democrats just told me they’re short of their crucial $250,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal. This is the LAST quarterly deadline before the election, making it the most important one of the entire cycle. Meanwhile, the first early votes are already being cast. **This is getting real: The election is here.**

If Democrats don’t reach this goal, then history-making Democratic senators like Raphael Warnock and Catherine Cortez Masto will have nothing to fight back with as they get pummeled by millions of dollars in attack ads. Promising Democratic candidates like Val Demings and Mandela Barnes won't get the support they need to break through.**

And then? Republicans will flip the Senate to undo all the progress President Biden and Senate Democrats have made in the last two years. They'll stop all the change you and I are still fighting for -- for years to come.

**If everyone reading this email right now took action today, we could make all the difference in this election.[ So please, I'm personally asking you to pitch in $5 before the end-of-quarter deadline to help defend and expand our already razor-thin Senate majority:](https://go.dscc.org/go/8670?amount=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220930-MartinSheen-SheenSigned1-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220930-MartinSheen-SheenSigned1-Pros-sl1&akid=7213%2E9716520%2EVQzDvu)**
