I’m so appreciative of all of the support you’ve shown as my team and I have been traveling the country to rally behind bold conservatives for the upcoming election. We’ve haven’t taken a beat since launching Stand For America PAC, and this final stretch is especially packed. I am pouring everything I have into electing Republicans up and down the ballot. I’ve endorsed, trained, advised, and financially supported nearly 60 conservatives in state and federal races. I’ve traveled to Georgia, New Hampshire, Nevada, Illinois, Texas, Indiana, New York, South Carolina, Pennsylvania — and that’s just in the past few weeks. **[But unfortunately, the only way my team can continue to fund these final weeks leading up to Election Day is if generous supporters like you step up.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=395b439ba56f4980b41b04eb44f6c7d6&_e=EX-kL2ySVRsT7XN0S39oHWz9oLWrWSSK8trj10WOb3z0FT90wQbyKlg38C4YBwkzML85IyCA2tg_dn7zSQaz1nBqERPNZsyxB5nb0cDtW40IcGxuEtAM5zKJ2SK2EPZL4HXxlF05jhTgCmgU8xJEvBIvZhHDP7MIP4A-Fdyg6cnxOSqnzihX9trQqaAHirDFybZhQEPkwZ8wSrhZWKS0gPSzPkFJvab4uhxbY2xhIjZ4Hyc4khgd9e0EusackfZzq0oDHWMx0aSS1nUmjSK5FBjrTygrcL_W5P3EDhThACid1ufoHtnM_Qm8Ag9quj1EHJqqW0sSfcLGHhMI51P23hWPMcHpZ_i3vn0iUhiz40M%3D) ** Every dollar you pour into our effort helps us do our part to get conservative leaders across the finish line. In just a matter of hours, Beto will hold Greg Abbott fully accountable while debating him in Edinburg. We’ve set a goal of raising $250,000 before Beto hits the stage tonight so we can show the power of our grassroots campaign to everyone across Texas.

Team Beto

| **Senator Pat Toomey Endorses Jeremy Shaffer for Congress**
---
| **Pittsburgh, PA** – Today, Senator Pat Toomey announced his endorsement of Western Pennsylvania entrepreneur and engineer Jeremy Shaffer in Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District.

"Jeremy Shaffer is a successful entrepreneur, proven problem-solver, and principled leader who will get things done in Washington on behalf of the people of Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District," said **Senator Pat Toomey**. "With Jeremy's small business and community experience, and track record of accomplishments, he is exactly the type of candidate Western Pennsylvania needs in Congress to deliver real results, and I'm proud to endorse him and know he will always put our country’s needs first."

"I'm absolutely honored to earn the endorsement of Senator Toomey," said **Jeremy Shaffer**. "Senator Toomey is a thoughtful, effective leader and man of integrity who has served Pennsylvania with distinction. His work with leaders in both parties to move our country forward is something I hope to continue in Congress." ###

Compare me to the alternative.” Well Derek, the choice couldn’t be clearer: On choice, Democrats want to codify Roe and Republicans want a national ban on abortion. Not only that, Democrats are working every day to build a better America, passing historic legislation like the Inflation Reduction Act and the American Rescue Plan to help lower costs \-- all without a single GOP vote. Take a look at congressional Republicans. What’s their platform? MAGA Republicans don’t just threaten our personal rights and economic security, they threaten our very democracy. They want to undo everything we’ve done. All that we've fought so hard for is on the ballot in just 39 days. name: Laurie Teper
subject: GOAL: One contact per day
body:
Team Geels,
This comes from a dedicated volunteer who offered his suggestions. Please take a look and focus on handing out AT LEAST one Courtney Geels palm card. All of your county coordinators have plenty to give out. Please contact them! We also have Hispanic palm cards

Some scenarios:
* with restaurant servers (leave a good tip!),
* with cashiers of all kinds in grocery stores or anywhere else (if there is no one waiting in line behind you) OR with the customers behind you as you are waiting
* with literally _anyone_ you interact with during the day.
* parents at soccer games (or any other sport)
* gas stations (conversation starter: I can't afford the gas!)
* pet groomers
* landscapers
* hair stylists
* small business owners

I've approached 25, maybe 30 people with **a rejection rate of 8%.** **2 out of 25 or more contacts** refused to accept a card. The others were interested and willing to take a look. Many said "I'll vote for her."

**Spanish speaking volunteers** can reach **hundreds to thousands** on most **any** Saturday at the Durham shopping center bounded by Avondale Drive, Roxboro Road and Club Boulevard. It is jam packed with Hispanic folks shopping, eating, hanging out. Imagine a table near Compare Foods and volunteers walking the entire parking lot between 11:00 AM and 4:00 PM. **Strategically I can think of NO BETTER WAY to deploy Spanish speaking volunteers in the critically important Durham campaign. This is for all intents and purposes a huge Hispanic festival/event held once a week. Also an awesome opportunity to register new voters who are hard working, family oriented and for many of them, God fearing people. I.e. COURTNEY people. We have registration forms!
**
**
**
**Another method to reach Hispanic voters** is to look for Hispanic work crews (tree service, lawn service, painters, etc) who are working outside someone's home. I have found in very limited efforts that they are more than open to receiving information--I'm keeping some Spanish palm cards in my car for such opportunities.

Here's my "SCRIPT"...

I'm a volunteer helping out the Courtney Geels for Congress campaign. Would you read this when you have time? She's a nurse, **not a politician** , and she has something we really need in Washington: **common sense.**

If walking up to someone outside a store or randomly, "Pardon me...could I have 30 seconds of your time?" and follow up with the "elevator speech" above.

I hope this helps you to help Courtney!

WE NEED YOU TO SIGN UP FOR WORKING THE POLLS - PLEASE CALL!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

You’re likely receiving many political fundraising emails these days for important causes and campaigns. I therefore greatly appreciate you taking the time to read this one.

[So, why should you donate to our race right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51687793/370114063/78570807?refcode=09-30-eoq3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWM3YTE5NS1mZDQwLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zDt_D-aPCKVYPhicI4lev8rQT_8ptIzBP4Twf-XpGog=) There are a handful of reasons:

Build Alaska's Future Action Fund now active! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8fbbcdce62a1/introducing-new-action-fund-help-create-positive-change?e=110fec2088)

[](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=a9e0e9d816&e=110fec2088)
Dear ,

While I stepped aside from the congressional race, I will continue to stay involved with initiatives making a positive impact in Alaska because I want to do what’s best for our state. Today, I would like to introduce you to a new 501c4 nonprofit [Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=dd510242b9&e=110fec2088), designed to help keep the conversation “on the rails.” While this project is focused on Alaska, we know what happens in our state makes a difference nationwide!The Action Fund ([BuildAK.org](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=0c856efbcc&e=110fec2088))**** is designed to promote the benefits of the billions of dollars of infrastructure money flowing to Alaska through education and advocacy.[**BuildAK.org**](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=fe740ebe18&e=110fec2088)**has already endorsed Senator Murkowski and Congresswoman Peltola** – the two candidates most dedicated to making sure Alaska gets as much infrastructure funding as possible. Meanwhile, extreme candidates such as [Kelly Tshibaka](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=308b626a5e&e=110fec2088), [Sarah Palin and Nick Begich](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=c9742a48f8&e=110fec2088) III are opposed to this funding, with some even saying they’d outright reject this transformational investment in our state.[Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=80cf8db5e3&e=110fec2088) can accept **unlimited corporate and individual contributions.** Their goal is to raise $500,000 by the end of this week to fund a statewide digital media campaign highlighting the benefits of the infrastructure funding and the people working to make sure Alaska gets its fair share.Please visit [BuildAK.org](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=73df11cee3&e=110fec2088) to get involved with this critical education and advocacy effort for Alaska and America.Thank you,Al Gross

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61459482:JD3duBVbN:m:1:3317145305:788F01BDDD6C26868D7F6EA7D606A32B:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you. I believe I am the best candidate for Wisconsin because I tell the truth and speak for the minority, even when the majority is doing everything they can to silence me.

Now that I have announced, the Left will seize every opportunity to destroy me politically. They will continue to write manipulative hit pieces and orchestrate smear campaigns across all mediums. They will attack and distort my record of success, my record of searching for the truth, and my record of fighting for the people of Wisconsin in any way they can. The Democrats even placed a $2M ad buy just moments after I announced my campaign for re-election.

And that's why I need your help.

_**[Any help you can provide will make an enormous difference and will be greatly appreciated. $25, $50, $100, or even $250 will help me respond to these hit pieces and smear campaigns. It will take all of us working together to defeat the Left and their dishonest tactics.

Ron Johnson

clean_body: Pro-choice candidates John Fetterman and Mandela Barnes are facing anti-choice extremists | | | Peter, Today is the FEC’s final end-of-quarter deadline before the election. As we look toward the final few weeks leading up to November 8, our ability to protect abortion rights everywhere is all going to come down to mobilizing voters in states like Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. There, pro-choice candidates John Fetterman and Mandela Barnes are facing anti-choice extremists. We have to put our strongest foot forward because the margins in the Senate are so slim — the GOP just needs a single additional seatto regain majority control. We’ve seen what they plan to do with a majority — undo decades of progress, alienate our nation’s most vulnerable, and sow hate and division. Even without a majority in the Senate, they’ve been able to block our progress on so many issues. But if we can flip just two seats — replacing Republicans with working families champions — we will win the majority necessary to not only reclaim our rights, but expand them. With those two extra votes we’ll finally be able to abolish the filibuster, codify Roe v. Wade into law, and much more. Abolishing the filibuster will make it possible for Senators to actually respond to the will of the people — and the will to restore abortion rights is strong: Polls show that vast majorities of Americans oppose the overturning of Roe v. Wade.1 56% of voters say abortion is “very important” for deciding their midterm votes.2 Across ten states after the Dobbs decision, the total number of women registering to vote increased by nearly 35%.3 Your contribution helps WFP support the candidates who will end the filibuster and defend reproductive freedom. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , CNN , January 21, 2022. 2\. , The New York Times , August 25, 2022. 3\. , The New York Times , August 25, 2022. Thoughts? Feedback? ---
Peter,

Time is flying by and we're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; **if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district.** If we don't, it's sayonara. No investment, nothing. I'll be on my own.

Today marks 40 days until Election Day and 1 day until the end of the 3rd quarter, meaning that as of this writing, **[I've only 1 day to meet their goal, or it's sayonara.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)** In case you missed it, I'm forwarding my original message from last week.

**[I'd be so appreciative if you were able to gift my campaign a couple dollars to help us reach this make-or-break fundraising goal](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)**.

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)
---

\-----Forwarded message-----
From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if**I**** can't, I'll be on my own till the end. ****************

With only 14 days to go, we're still short about $60,000. **[If you're in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)**

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)
---

Whether it's a test or not - I'm not taking any chances. While Oregon's 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it's ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you're on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r) **

My opponent this year is a the protege of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I'd like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker's gavel next Congress? Less than 10.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)
---

Thanks for your consideration, Peter

In service,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61455025:J3OD2BVPN:m:1:3253819041:A648D16B25B086DE960E472CDD4BCCA1:r)
Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

Friend,
We’re already halfway through Hispanic Heritage Month! And here at NextGen, we are using the month to celebrate the Latinx stars on our team and in our communities.
It’s never been more important to recognize the Latino community, as their contributions to the United States are remarkable, and the compensation received in return is abysmal — as recent as 2020, the average Latina earned 57.3% of the earnings of white men.
**This must change. And we have the progressive power to create change. **
After white Americans, Latinos are the largest voting demographic in the United States. And that voting bloc is constantly growing — every 30 seconds, a Latino becomes eligible to vote! It’s important that we have lawmakers who value the Latino community and keep our priorities in mind.
[Register to vote to elect lawmakers who will represent the Latino community.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51690934/370123388/1806988165?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWVlMmU0NS0wMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wqPtyiME4umgU0Wt7lgp0zoopqB9Mmmdjqovk7gJST0=&emci=7aee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=85ee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=6787172)
**This is your chance to use your voice.**
Here are a few voices from NextGen, both voters and nonvoters, to tell you a bit about why they think voting and organizing to vote is important.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51690935/370123389/-1278125550?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWVlMmU0NS0wMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wqPtyiME4umgU0Wt7lgp0zoopqB9Mmmdjqovk7gJST0=&emci=7aee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=85ee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51690936/370123390/-1278125550?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWVlMmU0NS0wMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wqPtyiME4umgU0Wt7lgp0zoopqB9Mmmdjqovk7gJST0=&emci=7aee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=85ee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=6787172)
**Natalie Monteiro **
_“I come from a family of hardworking immigrants who came to America in the late 70s. I grew up watching the efforts made by my family to help their children have a better life in a place where they were promised possibilities. Our struggles matched others in our communities and I started realizing that as a Latino community, we were being ignored. From our housing crisis to unfair wages, we have been dealing with these issues for years, and that won't change unless we come together to seek the justice the Latino community deserves. Since I turned 18, I knew helping my community was something I wanted to do, so I took action and started getting involved. But the first thing I did was register to vote because I knew that my voice could play a part in saving a democracy that helps all of us. Our fight is nowhere near over, but together, we have the power to elect progressive officials who will represent us in office.”_
**Sofia Garduño Araujo**
_“As a DACA recipient, I am unable to have my voice heard by voting. Despite this, I know I can still make a difference by getting others out to vote instead. By informing and mobilizing others to vote, I am still able to see the results I would hope to see if I were to vote myself. Elections have consequences, and that's why every single vote matters. I love being able to empower others to use the voice that so many others like myself wish they had. By bringing more people into the mix, we are able to create a more equitable and just government that actually represents us. Voting gives us a seat at the table to have a say in what happens to us. Even though I don't have a seat there yet, getting others to vote means I at least have someone there who will speak for me.”_
**Cesar Torres**
_“Civic duty and civic participation go beyond voting. Getting folks to vote is my way of participating. I encourage folks to register and vote not only for themselves but for their friends, family, and community. A lot of Latino families out there, like mine, are mixed-status. People like myself, a DACA recipient, have to rely on our community to lift us up. Letting folks know that they have families and communities on their shoulders and counting on them to vote is how I encourage folks to vote!”_
**Just as our voting bloc grows, so does our power to effect change.** We must elect officials to represent us to see those faces in positions of power like the House of Representatives, the Senate, and more.
[Make your voice heard and exercise your political power: Register to vote so you’re ready to cast your ballot on or before November 8.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51690937/370123391/240904224?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWVlMmU0NS0wMzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wqPtyiME4umgU0Wt7lgp0zoopqB9Mmmdjqovk7gJST0=&emci=7aee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=85ee2e45-0341-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=6787172)

clean_body: Registering to vote is our favorite way to party. | | | The change we deserve is possible. This Hispanic Heritage Month, join us in taking action. | | | Friend, We’re already halfway through Hispanic Heritage Month! And here at NextGen, we are using the month to celebrate the Latinx stars on our team and in our communities. It’s never been more important to recognize the Latino community, as their contributions to the United States are remarkable, and the compensation received in return is abysmal — as recent as 2020, the average Latina earned 57.3% of the earnings of white men. This must change. And we have the progressive power to create change. After white Americans, Latinos are the largest voting demographic in the United States. And that voting bloc is constantly growing — every 30 seconds, a Latino becomes eligible to vote! It’s important that we have lawmakers who value the Latino community and keep our priorities in mind. This is your chance to use your voice. Here are a few voices from NextGen, both voters and nonvoters, to tell you a bit about why they think voting and organizing to vote is important. Natalie Monteiro “I come from a family of hardworking immigrants who came to America in the late 70s. I grew up watching the efforts made by my family to help their children have a better life in a place where they were promised possibilities. Our struggles matched others in our communities and I started realizing that as a Latino community, we were being ignored. From our housing crisis to unfair wages, we have been dealing with these issues for years, and that won't change unless we come together to seek the justice the Latino community deserves. Since I turned 18, I knew helping my community was something I wanted to do, so I took action and started getting involved. But the first thing I did was register to vote because I knew that my voice could play a part in saving a democracy that helps all of us. Our fight is nowhere near over, but together, we have the power to elect progressive officials who will represent us in office.” Sofia Garduño Araujo “As a DACA recipient, I am unable to have my voice heard by voting. Despite this, I know I can still make a difference by getting others out to vote instead. By informing and mobilizing others to vote, I am still able to see the results I would hope to see if I were to vote myself. Elections have consequences, and that's why every single vote matters. I love being able to empower others to use the voice that so many others like myself wish they had. By bringing more people into the mix, we are able to create a more equitable and just government that actually represents us. Voting gives us a seat at the table to have a say in what happens to us. Even though I don't have a seat there yet, getting others to vote means I at least have someone there who will speak for me.” Cesar Torres “Civic duty and civic participation go beyond voting. Getting folks to vote is my way of participating. I encourage folks to register and vote not only for themselves but for their friends, family, and community. A lot of Latino families out there, like mine, are mixed-status. People like myself, a DACA recipient, have to rely on our community to lift us up. Letting folks know that they have families and communities on their shoulders and counting on them to vote is how I encourage folks to vote!” Just as our voting bloc grows, so does our power to effect change. We must elect officials to represent us to see those faces in positions of power like the House of Representatives, the Senate, and more. Thank you, NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51696963/370140853/1483338674?refcode=EM_FR_220930EOQ2_LBR_90DO_7_NG_TESTA_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODdhMTFiZC0wZTQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b4SEsv7eIBgK3tjYtnQmEorNAO289enWLtvWdc308YQ=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51696964/370140854/1483338674?refcode=EM_FR_220930EOQ2_LBR_90DO_7_NG_TESTA_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODdhMTFiZC0wZTQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b4SEsv7eIBgK3tjYtnQmEorNAO289enWLtvWdc308YQ=) **[I’m about to ask you one last time to chip in to my campaign to keep Delaware blue before the end-of-quarter deadline, but before I do that, I want you to know why investing in our Democratic progress is worth it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51696965/370140855/1483338674?refcode=EM_FR_220930EOQ2_LBR_90DO_7_NG_TESTA_L1&amount=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODdhMTFiZC0wZTQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b4SEsv7eIBgK3tjYtnQmEorNAO289enWLtvWdc308YQ=)** In politics, it’s always important to put your money where your mouth is. And to me, that means if Congress members are going to use your hard-earned dollars to get elected, then they need to prove to you that you made the right choice in trusting them. **That’s exactly why I’ve made it my mission to make you proud every single time I set foot in our nation’s capital.**

With your support, I’ve been able to join my Democratic colleagues in fighting some truly important battles on your behalf. We have made incredible strides in rebuilding our country’s crumbling infrastructure by providing funds to repave our roads, bolster up our bridges, and expand broadband access to millions of Americans. We’ve brought real relief to families by passing legislation that cuts down on inflation, creates new jobs, and takes aim at our student debt crisis.

The ad points to Casten’s history of self-dealing: raising taxes on working families, calling his salary “peanuts,” voting for congressional pay increases, and advocating and voting for a bill that would give large federal subsidies to a business in which he has significant financial investments.

The ad is Pekau’s second of the campaign. It features a constituent of Illinois Sixth Congressional district who discusses the impact Casten’s tenure in Congress has had on her family.

As we continue to expose the truth about Sean Casten, he is getting desperate. His campaign’s latest attack on me is full of false claims in an attempt to scare voters into re-electing him

Where are the fact-checkers when you need them?

The truth is that Sean Casten can’t run on his own record. He has used his seat in Congress to push for massive energy subsidies that benefit him and his family, and has done little to help the people of IL-06. In the past 3 years, Congressional Democrats and President Biden have walked the country into one unmitigated disaster after another - from Afghanistan, to the Southern Border, to our Supply Chain, to Energy. The economy is collapsing and crime is on the rise. He advocated and voted for the policies that have led us to this precarious point in our history. Moreover, Illinois Democrats - his own party - quietly put in place an anti-police, pro-criminal bill that is so dangerous it shocked the entire nation.

Casten also doesn’t want to talk about my record. As Mayor of Orland Park, we took a different path than the rest of the state and our economy has grown. Over 600 businesses have opened in Orland Park in the past 5 years. That means jobs for people in Orland Park. Crime has dropped to its lowest level in 27 years, because I prioritized working with law enforcement and keeping our citizens safe.”

So Casten has resorted to lying about my position. It’s the Democrat's playbook. They have governed so abysmally that their only hope is that they can scare enough people into believing their lies. It’s pathetic.

I don’t imagine he will quit this dishonest line of attack. He’s going to keep distorting my positions, and I am going to continue to tell the truth about him.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District

Michelle is a candidate who understands Texans who cannot travel hundreds of miles need in-state abortion care. She has continued to prove me right every step of the way in this campaign. She’s refused to compromise on her values or her platform — from protecting reproductive rights and affordable healthcare to ending gun violence and strengthening voting rights. She’s up against a Trump-endorsed Republican candidate with the entire weight of the far-right behind her. Michelle won’t be able to win this race alone, we need you in this fight with us, Peter. And there’s a reason there’s national attention around this race: it could determine if we keep our majority in the House and turn Texas blue. And to do that, Michelle is exactly the person we need to get behind. Michelle is a hard-working, community-oriented, remarkable young woman, and these qualities will serve the people of TX-15 well. It’s Scott Kelly, Mark’s twin brother and fellow astronaut!

name: Ron Johnson
subject: This is a personal plea, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61459487:6KYfvBVnN:m:1:3253819041:CACDB7A8BE5BFC76A7063FF3ADE78069:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.****************As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61459488:6KYfvBVnN:m:1:3253819041:CACDB7A8BE5BFC76A7063FF3ADE78069:r "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?")**_**************************************

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: A personal request
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
My team encouraged me to write to you.
#
Peter,
I talked to my team this morning and they told me we’re just about $5,000 shy of our end-of-quarter goal – so I wanted to reach out personally to make a request.
**We have to reach this goal, Peter – so I can continue to lead the fights for Medicare for All, abolishing the filibuster, protecting reproductive rights, and so much more.**
As I said, right now we’re just $5,000 short of our goal to raise $30,000 by the time our financial quarter closes at midnight tonight. **If we do that, we’ll hit an incredible $350,000 raised this quarter – that’s a game-changing amount for us.**
Peter, I’ll be honest, I am a little worried we won’t reach our goal, but I have faith in our grassroots movement. [**That’s why I’m hoping I can count on your support one final time this quarter. Will you chip in whatever you can before midnight and help us reach $350,000?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18369?refcode=em20220930-1668&t=1&akid=1668%2E420207%2EBMYyMa)
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18369?refcode=em20220930-1668&t=2&akid=1668%2E420207%2EBMYyMa)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18369?refcode=em20220930-1668&t=21&akid=1668%2E420207%2EBMYyMa)**
**We all know how important this midterm election is,** and we need progressives to be in the best possible position come November 8th. Strong fundraising allows us to run the best possible campaign, while also supporting other trailblazing progressives all over the country.
**It’s your support that powers our movement and allows me to stay in Congress term after term so I can fight for you.** I take that responsibility very seriously, which is why I know how important it is that we raise that final $5,000 today.
[**I know that you’re one of my most engaged supporters, Peter, so I’m asking you personally now – can you rush a donation of $3 or any amount to support me one last time before our quarter ends at midnight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/18369?refcode=em20220930-1668&t=22&akid=1668%2E420207%2EBMYyMa)
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220930-1668-footer&t=23&refcode2=1668_420207_BMYyMa&akid=1668%2E420207%2EBMYyMa)**
---

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, and small-dollar contributions sustain our movement for transformative change. To contribute by check, please address to Pramila for Congress, PO Box 21912, Seattle, WA 98111.

Fellow American,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** In June, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. **She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.**

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’ve been trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

**[I'm asking 35 conservatives reading this right now to make a gift to my campaign before midnight. The race between Michelle and I could be equally as close as her primary race; we MUST be prepared for that possibility.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=aee7bbd3da61419fb6e96a2e44f424b9&_e=dQhn0Jy3b73NRNgN8KyziESCz41zskqDRqf_lbkTEJfb9p8bIbc5iO2M-FR1ESo6g89nV7yOgs9x6nXamZGNmGllo8ehdCTH4-9asRuAbd9fwWxhJBxDJBkjbfY3-F8hcFtTajA-a4_5S7e6JtrDHXb-XNBSzO8pYqSmIytlgTSvbYpMLmdtmN6ABCsBRaZmX8S1WsMV3TekUXMsi1BzCoPv3HmsUHo9gut4fCuJLBVLGySPFFV_Smc7fDA_ej_xVSA4IDczFmz4Katb92BzCF9JBnT8lKf-qdpHSvYnupMSeBpYReFYJZ9lA7raH81GNlb3QDXrsCILY5DBaQAOUy0Q9UKNLVbSie0Q3lSHGl6pyBbI5k4A_Lf3Zq7SJUjh57fabE9_buGIAirfL6gnCLeVH3aAwn58XSj4R36bOQE%3D) **

[** 35 Donations
Needed by Midnight ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=aee7bbd3da61419fb6e96a2e44f424b9&_e=dQhn0Jy3b73NRNgN8KyziESCz41zskqDRqf_lbkTEJfb9p8bIbc5iO2M-FR1ESo6g89nV7yOgs9x6nXamZGNmGllo8ehdCTH4-9asRuAbd9fwWxhJBxDJBkjbfY3-F8hcFtTajA-a4_5S7e6JtrDHXb-XNBSzO8pYqSmIytlgTSvbYpMLmdtmN6ABCsBRaZmX8S1WsMV3TekUXMsi1BzCoPv3HmsUHo9gut4fCuJLBVLGySPFFV_Smc7fDA_ej_xVSA4IDczFmz4Katb92BzCJRurAi2JLxZXoOdaDpeW9DiJ9-nYIl22VdLI4Rv63EdZYpMivRZiacsdarFJqffgwOLqF8r6oSn_QZP5BcyMSinyCm4VHjbSh-6gmNjx3iGwTvRHUdJ6U89qfowWp2wb7W_NhxNjiY0XR300MO8jPY%3D)

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5ffe8f5b53ac456f89ea76659a74574e&_e=HOEf4EzUr2GR-_F7TtVjgjGNVx8-4Hr20A7zHFXZsfcVE7LdIsLbGrqJeBWc5ojHj3q-YeH6kSGNmCQBzAM3Ux22NZ3G7Z9l8ivLNnY3iWM7lO3l4zHvZMJtNUjK-HR5_SYKQjjendLkz5YiJQheJ4hGe_k3sSyIXWWB8AtN6Iner4WoJy-1vRpVwzQSdo1iYlIRnDxTt5QufxvHZ8BP30nCmx0KyIDANr07dHPFh5VbkqJBZ4j9z47VvP-bjx3K_oob0CezDGESYJtCQ1KKpdQyILv5UImHa98lyYANF-Rm9XMXOiSWtA5DIuv2ScQcMNlrTTUpoiJ79wW_coiUhMqSX4gd5aF2Awy2P_W5pgaiiELghiJHROS_pB_sLL4K)**

* Overpopulation is destroying the world

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51703210/370157403/1120393829?refcode=em-wrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmYyNmQ5OC0xYjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wRypymYNsz9rKqJO6PqfNkeEX7Bfj9ftQY6UIl6f0i4=&emci=0ef26d98-1b41-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&emdi=1ff26d98-1b41-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&ceid=6830379)
There is an organizing truth I want to share with you, Peter. The fight for progress, civil rights, and dignity is long, grueling, and unending. _**But it’s always worth it.**_
**That’s why it’s critical that our campaign keeps up the fight for progress in Texas and across the country.[Can I ask you to chip in $5 to help us meet our $4,520 goal before midnight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51703211/370157404/124625982?refcode=em-20220930&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmYyNmQ5OC0xYjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wRypymYNsz9rKqJO6PqfNkeEX7Bfj9ftQY6UIl6f0i4=)**
**[CHIP IN »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51703212/370157405/371014886?refcode=em-20220930&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmYyNmQ5OC0xYjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wRypymYNsz9rKqJO6PqfNkeEX7Bfj9ftQY6UIl6f0i4=)**

**Our opponents know how to play the long game.** It took 50 years to dismantle _Roe v. Wade_. It took session after session of slowly chipping away at our voting rights for us to get where we are today. And it also took tremendous resources to keep unionization efforts at an all-time low for decades.
[**We must be prepared to meet them head on. If you’re able, please chip in what you can to help us continue to invest in progressive campaigns, drive unionization efforts, and turn out the vote in November. Every dollar you contribute goes directly to fighting for a better tomorrow.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51703213/370157406/371014886?refcode=em-20220930&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmYyNmQ5OC0xYjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wRypymYNsz9rKqJO6PqfNkeEX7Bfj9ftQY6UIl6f0i4=)
To the future we’re building together,
Greg

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=1ee6d6ce377b4bcfbaf4a62c724920dd&_e=g7tdqBB_f5ZY1F_cxmCSuE9nFs2jt4rmh3LZcrz_CPaGIksrJsnMAdFYUiClLYYOgqQxvehIfBXBwe_IF-q6khMJvLMTIpVvuQ2tC52KcZxwfEmJyL9DhaacTQIkwh33tpazOchY0SOnjBj1Ndy-DoDiyLuNRjMSWozRjIB0GW5rkAA5jljaaeqYQdo5gXl_qbzw0zDnclIiokIcm7GCUYfmw1k96IBf92TTxbxiqaU%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=1ee6d6ce377b4bcfbaf4a62c724920dd&_e=g7tdqBB_f5ZY1F_cxmCSuE9nFs2jt4rmh3LZcrz_CPaGIksrJsnMAdFYUiClLYYOgqQxvehIfBXBwe_IF-q6kprBsLKKTYd5CTUW-KQW6jIfThn0tnLyf7q5VyJGW_UV6y-tnfDTU68U_fS20b3tmtTXfxV0R1Yufo8XFZJMz4U_x8NGFHQMKSNraPS0ApUe9mxw4pAoLzTduUW9q7Ft8oirP2DAp47uHQLD6UNTOIU%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a4372f76ca0c4ef7bc6ff9015f4a051f&_e=tV577JPA6rln5AUt4G-1NgQ_H4TClRdxH8Rs9f1eZ2iqUBZmJ0RgWZUe9sumnyMUjGYtBA9BarX4n2gEClNaxFt1Mc6__XdSeBAQl83Uj2gGCN8RmZfo0hd5Im2Pks08sfmbLO2dCKPOIFPPiOztXJgj_I_fgVA5DFk7wCzaCP6zCodPgrw06uvX14o58-EykkYKKElUIaNNM5ZN0zO-JigzAx0r5wKZRtvopBneALeUFbaikRtuzxTbTY3cIL714D1qsLjLdw5rvZIjgLatbwHXWw6kChEfn-HwfkSqAnN5NH5Nsj9HWCBN57AD6RuuhT5kktmdBiJFerSU2fAtA05vRwxy8Vji7yn6BQ0knlSgishmXdLNWWB6613F4WY_IMigOJopDt-D6T1LFYRk4GU8XhJiINntrQ_Wr97JNMbcI7GU_mHMEz4HwxidloZs)

The way I see it, we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines and hope our rights and freedoms get restored. We’ve got to fight, and my hope is that I can count on you to join me. _Keep reading to learn more about our work to defeat Ron Johnson and save Governor Tony Evers' veto — and how you can get involved right now._

clean_body: | Team — When I ended my U.S. Senate campaign, I made a promise to so many of our supporters: I told you I wasn’t going anywhere, and that I would always be in the fight to restore and protect reproductive freedom in Wisconsin. I'm keeping that promise by launching a new political action committee called . Our mission is to mobilize women voters and elect pro-choice Democratic candidates in some of the toughest races throughout Wisconsin. Over the next few weeks, all of our efforts will go toward unseating Ron Johnson and supporting pro-choice women running in the most competitive state legislative elections of the cycle — races that will determine whether or not Governor Tony Evers has the power to veto dangerous bills passed by the Republican-led legislature. The way I see it, we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines and hope our rights and freedoms get restored. We’ve got to fight, and my hope is that I can count on you to join me. Keep reading to learn more about our work to defeat Ron Johnson and save Governor Tony Evers' veto — and how you can get involved right now. Women Against Ron (WAR) Between now and Election Day, WAR will work to unseat Ron Johnson by putting his anti-woman agenda directly in front of Wisconsin voters — especially women voters, who will be critical in the outcome of this tied race. Voters need to know the truth about Ron Johnson's extreme record on issues like abortion, childcare, equal pay, and so much more. We're going to make sure they get the facts before November through investments in digital advertising and targeted voter outreach in Wisconsin. | = Women Save the Veto Wisconsin Republicans only need to win six seats to gain a legislative supermajority — giving them enough votes to override Governor Evers’ veto and push through draconian laws infringing on our private health care decisions. Governor Evers has already vetoed nine anti-abortion bills that passed the GOP-controlled legislature. He also called for a special session to create a path for voters to repeal the cruel 1849 abortion ban that was reinstated when Roe was overturned. We need to make sure Governor Evers is re-elected and save the veto. That’s why Women Save the Veto is supporting pro-choice Democratic women running in six of the most competitive state legislative races in order to block a GOP supermajority, save the governor’s veto power, and ensure we have more pro-choice leaders fighting for our rights in the state legislature. Electing these six women will be critical to the future of abortion policy in Wisconsin. We’ll work to arm endorsed candidates with the financial resources, strategic support, and infrastructure necessary to mobilize pro-choice voters in their districts and win. But we’re going to need a lot of help to get this done. = Women Win Wisconsin is going to build on the power of pro-choice women to restore reproductive freedom and win close elections across our battleground state — this November and beyond. But our work will be what supporters like you make of it, and by getting involved now, you'll help shape it from the very beginning. This isn’t my fight alone — we’re a team. So I’m asking you to join me in the tough work ahead of us, just like you did when I ran for U.S. Senate. We’re just getting started, so be sure to keep an eye out for other emails from me. What comes to mind when you hear the question: “What is the number one cause of death for Americans aged 18-45?” Car accidents? _No._ Suicide? _No._ COVID-19? _No._ Since 2020, the [leading cause](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=06af7c59cd4f40a7bbe3e54864a7e0aa&_e=JBFbFB92ILHiSjNFqEOYCs-pBfDNMCOvWJwD8O_fD8dJQfoskgY7qmuFUEe-RLUYmAwzA8icb0esHV6E8Iton3LsJt75-YsNY8Csb39HsJu5E9-iLWvpJqUxK-xTSro3XhN-BXMz6R9Ra5G7MelcJDW4sWV5xDgjYXztHqzDYK_gLEWaIThFhtpZty2Erl65yCJ-g-Nir5qAzipQJzHQlUA38IeNhYyGUwFzPU27rWo%3D) of death for this group is fentanyl overdoses. Here’s a staggering statistic—nearly 154 Americans die from fentanyl daily. To put that in perspective, that is the equivalent of [38 mass shootings.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=06af7c59cd4f40a7bbe3e54864a7e0aa&_e=JBFbFB92ILHiSjNFqEOYCnIanyOi8a-f-Tjp5gZomFE1AS1LSt9Pb9OVRPLq-faIM515vmz_YB6IWEZ2ANDRmM--eJtOz0o42bxrtrCqK2IjsJExrmLt9bPd7F5UnlCFEdUOoQM5Z37MnfLuMrYlHzpMDMKvhUB_DaBl0H0jo9YGkUcsWkXKQY7AIUYLJhy1lR8MwMm17kVQGOTCDE3ZD7JX3xdTDaiHfwYjmosLW2flsqIzeu0NKzN3Pa64nDpf5mYcfrLbnSF-L7irJwSw2e44NjdyPv8q6E9-0M4ePgw%3D) What is Democrat-controlled Washington doing about this? That’s why I am pushing for more severe punishments for drug traffickers with the [Fentanyl Traffic Elimination Act.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=06af7c59cd4f40a7bbe3e54864a7e0aa&_e=JBFbFB92ILHiSjNFqEOYCg_QDFEPAxlsL275h8Jhgxou8nmvbm59ookCODuuhePeQQb-PXX9com4b2FxmXSr2ZuIYGBlOprPe_zL1e9SP816dBkcCB6ZB3BRCDafvC_-MZgAsBfT1WgofpXn6VsIg2GTGpPzY00gMspowrTcpU0CSWGtYIs7XZ6HGSrXUS7bBjai63MHcWkHhtr-TrASPvr9-WENffn2jLqg_1t6o3dAbaQPROvZ3iC60RjkekE0X5MReYnMVNwkdrMDm8uZVg5f2D9UIJX3nASJZQvMM3E%3D) It is long overdue. The energy we’re seeing on the ground continues to grow by the day. Alabamians are ready to send a message and stand up for the future of our state on November 8! | | Keeping Our Kids Safe As parents, we used to be able to keep our children safe at night by locking the doors. body:
The Kansas gubernatorial race showcases a Democratic vulnerability. Kansas governor Laura Kelly, a Democrat, released an ad last week saying, “You have seen my opponent’s attacks. So let me just say it: Of course men should not play girls sports. Okay, we all agree there.”| | |

| | **ICYMI: Democratic Trans Hypocrisy Is Cynical and Dishonest** **By Rich Lowry**[ _September 26, 2022, The National Review_](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=d0f6943e03504799841bffd9bd05e986&_e=VpfTfj9SKtDkGwCoTH_JUDWQK61yTqIEvVP0xhpeduJSB234hLsyr-eL-15LRnyTg13Fv72FgyPoQhbWpf-XhOU0us3CW_jzf-9cY2hNp0qPzGYeI9GC6cpiHFfbhCD2-l5_PCVBSUUQem82GbOdISvxOi_YJ3zq2x0nu0J6-sByMfPWp--HzKAyk10kVQe1rCySpwVGFar0o1dduUk9MuaCsXa9AOZvdhnDiFCj-44I7ZDuXDPYWchu7Gwp6Q_mCY3EQueoUoflf-RZprP6MboXCjGi5HJXIFK_cP7fowI%3D) The Kansas gubernatorial race showcases a Democratic vulnerability.

Kansas governor Laura Kelly, a Democrat, released [an ad](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=d0f6943e03504799841bffd9bd05e986&_e=VpfTfj9SKtDkGwCoTH_JUDQv5t5wxROdomWLoUStsEcn90JzWtJdtv9dFCHU4BFQ_T01OXBOa9H8ucnA9t1-fy55ICsOtBpulmTdGqB4haufrhMbdzv9_JL23n_uZQijSTOPQmBD0za4nf0hnKVrM5P1vhK-b5u5duM3pyAS34gjm9ketaT7QKODHc0aQM6bS1cngTzLer_bKmDkKsLTZDKZOTbmU--6pfkkslAOablAoXBCftqVasgY7dd7pkY6FJNOf4STqMKUNhDkfctYwoqGLXUVpXndLVIGrMNG2WlCFVvn5GOJ7aU14--Q8FCM6ggsN8pYIeI_ljY_mssI-5FIr694L6T8VkXjmN9xyyapdxs2fDw4JR4LcBiGJTZEsUxxIlkd-1E7k27H0Oqbaw%3D%3D) last week saying, “You have seen my opponent’s attacks. So let me just say it: Of course men should not play girls sports. Okay, we all agree there.”

The ad is an attempt at defensive culture-war politics — and also brazenly dishonest and cynical. Democrats would be better off if they were willing to associate themselves with broadly popular, commonsensical views on a host of culturally charged issues. _Of course, we don’t support teaching CRT in public schools. Of course, we think illegal immigrants at the border should be excluded and promptly sent home. Of course, we support some restrictions on abortion.

_ This would this take the edge off their radicalism, give Republicans less to shoot at, and increase Democratic appeal to fence-sitting moderates. As Kelly demonstrates, some Democrats feel compelled to say such things, but these kinds of assurances generally aren’t forthcoming from the national Democratic Party.

It would be even better, of course, if Democrats who say the right things actually mean them. Instead — again, as Kelly shows — they are often engaged in transparent efforts to reduce their political vulnerability, while blocking policies informed by the sentiments they are trying to co-opt.

For all that Kelly wants to sound like a reasonable moderate on trans sports, she vetoed bills in both 2021 and 2022 to keep males from competing in girls’ sports. A spokesperson for Kelly [said](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=d0f6943e03504799841bffd9bd05e986&_e=VpfTfj9SKtDkGwCoTH_JUL1_Mn0Y8BNJsX_LWPeazl13TpeGSK5iHtGObjGJ7M2iqNoMvZlT_62GxdhgLoMFf1pTsC40WnX0_yXqLZ7q8euv4VG4DSjoILM777C2868T9Y_4WXSzMt-7jBIS1CagH0-qere2uJvnot16_3jjaUrBim2ENUxi2mKaImTb_QrQ5JVFH7Pyv8RXMYVBLywg0W9vFBM_gn1fSGYDGv911Gx7U0ekemoFkgwPNCtW0CSdYCiV3ISpOGudfehQiMegIxoQz2FBe80M2q1nIG77AAOom6213ERVI41I-2LNP7YUzW3vMgf942iHLpZPopGUzk-yKW7934xTPuJiX93fxPpJtDc8ht_JIBK4DcTh2sSv6VQwgAGpnMP34I0UFqvqtJMask3M3InQ_pVBSn38ZN6plsZIZnVu3HKfJMRN06GXd56_BfDrtPtP5vK3rRq1g3-2jt35mIV3rd0cEi8D7Dg%3D), “These decisions should be made by medical professionals, school officials, families, and local jurisdictions — not politicians.”

The problem, though, is that the purveyors of trans-radicalism are so determined — and have such an ability to cajole and cow any institution or official who is not a committed opponent of the agenda — that the only reliable vehicle for pushing back is the political process.

Conservatives are right to agitate for rules against males distorting and demeaning girls’ sports — and to make Democrats defend the indefensible.

Kelly came out with her ad under pressure from her Republican opponent Derek Schmidt, who has been hitting the issue hard. clean_body: Protecting and expanding our congressional majorities must be a top priority, and tonight marks the final end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. | | Derek: With a Democratic Congress fighting alongside Joe and Kamala, we’ve made historic progress for working people and families. We can’t stop that momentum now -- too much is at stake. That’s why protecting and expanding our congressional majorities is our top priority, especially as we approach the final end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day tonight. It doesn’t look like you’ve donated yet this year, so can I count on you to chip in $7 to help the DNC continue electing Democrats at all levels nationwide? We’ve already made tremendous progress together, but this November, some of Joe’s crucial partners in the House and Senate are on the ballot. If we want to keep making progress for families across this country, we have to make sure they win in November. We can’t do that without you. With only 39 days left, Democrats are entering the most important stretch of this campaign. We need to ensure these candidates at all levels of government have every necessary resource to win. name: Cheri Beasley
subject: re: our official FEC deadline
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
The truth is I’m reaching out today with a request today because we have an important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of the month.
| Hello -

First and foremost, I want to say thank you to everybody who has supported our grassroots campaign. I am so grateful to the more than 100,000 people who have helped us get to where we are - less than 2 months from making history. It is humbling.

The truth is I’m reaching out with a request today because we have an important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month. Will you please consider making a contribution to our grassroots campaign to help us hit our ambitious goal? Please use this link to give: [**https://act.protectvoting.org/go/elect-Beasley**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28045?t=6&akid=4755%2E878179%2EvHlHe6) We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Right after Labor Day, everything kicked into an even higher gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars.

Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’re doing right now. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.

My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where economic inequality only gets worse.

I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.

But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone. [**So I’m humbly asking you to split a $7 contribution to our campaign and Voter Protection Project today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. Our end-of-quarter FEC deadline is almost here, and it is critical that we reach our goal and raise the resources necessary to compete with the super PACs trying to buy this seat. »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28045?t=7&akid=4755%2E878179%2EvHlHe6) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Cheri Beasley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28046?t=8&akid=4755%2E878179%2EvHlHe6)

Thank you in advance for making a donation.

We have to give this our all because every dollar donated, every voter registered, and every door knocked will matter when the votes are counted.

\- Cheri

Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** In June, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. body:
Derek, I wish I was reaching out with better news:
#
Derek,
After two polls last month showed me TIED with Marco Rubio, a recent poll just came out: **It's 45-46. We're trailing Rubio by ONE POINT in the race that could decide Senate control.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220930-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220930-7521&refcode2=7521_434096_kc0R3D&akid=7521%2E434096%2Ekc0R3D)
**This poll is a major step back** , Derek, there's no way around that. I'm getting outspent in key areas of Florida, and we're running out of time to fix this.
**After I became the official Democratic nominee for Florida's Senate seat, Rubio launched _another_ $1.3 MILLION in new attack ads,** and clearly they're beginning to resonate with voters.
As you read this, Rubio, Mitch McConnell and the GOP are gearing up to pour even _more_ money into this race to bombard us with nonstop attack ads from now until Election Day. Why? Because the GOP knows that I can defeat Rubio, and when I do, it will virtually guarantee that Democrats keep Senate control.
**If we're going to counter their attacks, take the lead and protect our Senate majority, we need to hit our big end-of-quarter goal – and I simply can't get there without your immediate donation.**
**[That's why I'm asking you directly: Will you donate $5 to split between my campaign and John Fetterman right now to help me take the lead in the polls, defeat Marco Rubio and defend our Democratic Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220930-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220930-7521&refcode2=7521_434096_kc0R3D&akid=7521%2E434096%2Ekc0R3D)**

__
I know that with supporters like you by my side, we can do this. We can win this race. Thank you so much for all you do.
– Val Demings

Team,
Tonight is our final quarterly FEC deadline before the general election on November 8, which means it’s **one of our last opportunities to show our grassroots strength and our commitment to a more progressive Senate.**
**Right now, we have a knife’s edge Senate split 50/50.** And with our entire progressive agenda on the line—lowering prescription drug costs, a Green New Deal, Medicare for All, reproductive justice—and so much more, we can’t risk Mitch McConnell retaking the Senate. In 3 hours, I’m facing my FINAL end-of-quarter FEC fundraising deadline of the entire campaign. After midnight tonight, we're required by federal law to show everyone how much our people-powered campaign has raised to retire Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue.
**But right now, we’re still just $9,165 short of our goal, so I have to ask:** [**Please, will you chip in $5 or more right now – before our final end-of-quarter FEC deadline at midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51713574/370196739/-42398318?refcode=em20220930pm2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODAzM2VjNy0yYzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iShcuowQ10oabC2dN47jJ4RMsrNJ4nStx2BnQUiy_ZA=)
Chuck Grassley is one of the biggest recipients of corporate PAC and special interest money in the Senate. His campaign is bankrolled by the NRA, Big Pharma, and Wall Street donors – even Fox News. But that’s not our campaign.

body:
Getting out the vote now is more important than ever.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51713613/370196802/-849735382?refcode=EM_FR_220930Progress_EOM_SB_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTAzM2VjNy0yYzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NXGK_2IDSDMm0m8vrEFuE5isAn3VIt5FQbHgyr6puFE=) Peter, time is running out.

When Democrats took Congress in 2020, we did so because the American people trusted us to deliver for them. Looking back on everything we’ve accomplished, I can say that trust was rewarded with progress.

So far, we’ve delivered on funding our critical infrastructure, tackled inflation rates, enacted crucial gun violence prevention measures, and now, education affordability. All this progress was only possible because of our Democratic majority in Congress, but this November, everything we’ve accomplished is up for grabs.

[**_So I’m asking you, Peter, can I count on you to contribute $5 to protect all the progress we’ve made and ensure Democrats come out on top this November? With Election Day in less than 6 weeks and early voting starting even sooner, there’s no time to waste._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51713614/370196803/-849735382?refcode=EM_FR_220930Progress_EOM_SB_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_l1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTAzM2VjNy0yYzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NXGK_2IDSDMm0m8vrEFuE5isAn3VIt5FQbHgyr6puFE=) [RUSH YOUR DONATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51713615/370196804/-849735382?refcode=EM_FR_220930Progress_EOM_SB_90DO_7_NG_TESTB_b1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTAzM2VjNy0yYzQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NXGK_2IDSDMm0m8vrEFuE5isAn3VIt5FQbHgyr6puFE=) With all the achievements made possible by our Democratic majority, it’s important to remember that these achievements are not set in stone.

If the GOP takes back Congress this November, their first priority will be to roll back everything we’ve accomplished so far. Even worse, **the GOP will introduce new legislation to implement a federal abortion ban** and take their radical anti-choice policies to the national level. Election Day is fast approaching, and we need all hands on deck if we’re going to prevent this GOP takeover from occurring.

It’s important to remember voting doesn’t just start on Election Day. With early voting starting soon, the window for us to reach undecided voters and maintain our Democratic majority is dwindling. * I also recently secured **$6.88 million for environmentally-friendly transportation** infrastructure investments on the West Bank and in Jefferson Parish.
* To help our businesses recover from the COVID-19 pandemic, I introduced the Revitalizing Small and Local Businesses Act which would create a new program to get resources into the hands of the local organizations that help our small businesses thrive. I also co-sponsored a bill to provide **$60 billion in new funding to help restaurants recover.**
* In the face of violence across our nation and in our region, I co-sponsored the **Protecting Our Kids Act, which prohibits the sale of semi-automatic firearms** to people under 21 years old, regulates ghost guns, establishes new gun trafficking laws, and more.

Hey, Peter – I *just* got off the stage in Albuquerque, where I faced off against my extremist, pro-Trump opponent, Mark Ronchetti.
**I made our message clear tonight to viewers at home: New Mexico cannot turn red, and it certainly should not be led by a Trump-style Republican who wants to ban abortion.**

body:
I’m glad I caught you, Peter.

I’m reaching out one last time before tonight’s _final_ quarterly fundraising deadline with the FEC. As it stands, we’re only $10,000 short of our stretch goal. That’s incredible, but we do need a last-minute boost to get across the finish line.

I know my team has been in touch quite a bit this week – _sorry about that._ But with the stakes so high, I wouldn’t be doing right by my team or our supporters if I didn’t send one last email to try and close this gap.

Before you break for the weekend, will you chip in a quick contribution to help us meet this benchmark? Your contribution could put us over the top!

Here’s a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51697618/370142795/-295409223?refcode=em-9.30.22-all-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjg4YjE2ZC0wZjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XexFm-CM9TH1lm05uv8Pe697EuM7nsKm5YnGC2TDxmA=)**

That’s good news, but the fact is we are being outspent. We need an exceptionally strong fundraising quarter if we’re going to counter the attack ads coming our way.

Your support will go directly to work making sure voters know that I’m the candidate they can trust. If you’re with me, chip in to give us a boost in this ultra-competitive campaign. **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51697619/370142796/-295409223?refcode=em-9.30.22-all-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjg4YjE2ZC0wZjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XexFm-CM9TH1lm05uv8Pe697EuM7nsKm5YnGC2TDxmA=)**

Friend,

This Saturday, Donald Trump is hosting a rally in Macomb County for Kristina Karamo and her fellow election deniers. We know it’s going to be a day filled with anti-democratic demagoguery and lies. But it’s up to us to make sure that it does not change the momentum in this race.
This rally is happening for a very specific and terrifying reason. With less than six weeks until Election Day, Trump only has a handful of opportunities to gather his MAGA supporters for a weekend rally and whip up support for his hand-picked candidates. Think about that, friend. We’re in the final stretch of this campaign and Donald Trump is coming to Michigan to rally his base for Kristina Karamo.
We can’t let Trump’s rally this weekend give Karamo a boost in this race. Pitch in $10 to help Jocelyn’s re-election campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=092722]
The last time Trump and Karamo appeared together, they charged attendees $25,000 just to have a picture taken with them. The worst part of it all? People actually paid the money. Unfortunately, there will be people in Michigan willing to go along with their money-raising scheme.
But we know the pro-democracy movement is a much bigger political force in our state.
That’s why we’re stepping up our messaging efforts over these final weeks to make sure Jocelyn keeps up the momentum and defeats Karamo on Election Day. Will you contribute today to help make that possible? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=092722]

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: These are real deadlines that have a real impact on our work. | | | If you’re on other political email lists, we’re sure you’re getting a lot of emails right now, Peter. But please, spare us a minute of your time to explain why we need your support today: In just 39 days, all of our work to elect WFP champions will come to a head on election night. And with so little time left on the clock, we cannot afford to slow down or reduce our organizing efforts. Because of your generous support, we've been able to keep WFP organizers and volunteers on the ground. For months, they've been working in communities across the country, connecting with voters and spreading our shared vision for a better future for all. We have made enormous strides, powering eight Congressional candidates and over forty new candidates for state legislature to victory in Democratic primaries. If we're going to accelerate this crucial work in the final 39 days of the election, we need to hit our $13,000 fundraising goal before tonight’s end-of-quarter FEC deadline. Which is why we’re asking one more time: Your support will help fund our organizers on the ground, expand our volunteer efforts, and get more ads running to support WFP champions. With so much on the line — from abortion access to voting rights to addressing the climate crisis — every single donation, no matter the size, will make a difference.
