| | Hi there, Peter — it’s Quentin & Stefanie, co-founders of The Collective PAC. We know it’s late, but we wanted to reach out personally one final time before midnight.

First of all, we want to say that our entire team is so grateful for committed supporters like you who step up to defend our democracy time and time again. Your dedication to our candidates is truly inspiring. With our last end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day tonight at midnight, we wanted to reach out personally and share our vision for progress.

Uplifting progressive Black champions _all across the country_ is critical in ensuring our values are front and center. With reproductive freedom, voting rights, and our democracy itself all under attack, our endorsed candidates are our first and strongest line of defense.

It’s up to us to power our candidates to victory and create a government that truly represents the country and is committed to protecting its people — and with our most critical deadline of the entire cycle at **midnight tonight,** we’re counting on your support.

**Peter, this is our last chance to gather the resources we need to give our endorsed candidates the best chances of winning this year, and we’re reaching out to you for a reason. We know we can count on supporters like you to step up to the plate when you know what’s at stake. As we approach the last hours of our most important FEC deadline, we are still short $2,354 of our goal.**

[There has never been a more important time to step up and support The Collective PAC for the first time, will you please make a contribution of $10 tonight?](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zd08Cnt8yETzp0d4OIwup9bnSy7tq169h4R3LXPHgZBSape01ghjcpVDEedGEYdNTMMxhWWTyfu4Wv-9M5XFglbS6bjAUauQ41WszTOpQWZT_6HRG0-WsIyh088AZcyn9oPCZXiQSruRQ_7sxj-yeZn0o0LoanK_jwZ_oruDX4eAMXnN3SkXruXMqhYTzaBLBl8ZZoO8zsRss8DrVHLR9DK4RvIfW0hQCIsprX391Zazooh4ixDsbzd9kzy-NB1c_xQd3paPTHNVwTjNQxNq_idxwvCB-rcKoVn3JEPRzzQmHGDehIf6fQfRius24sX6E/3pw/W3617PTPSfaKsx0uzgcfiw/h1/j00lXJHDZnpnW672MRhZGxib2H7RpE_ZBf_L0H9gxZs)

# **Newsletter-September 30 Vol. 2, #32**
---
| | |
##
30 September 22

Mail-In Ballots are now in the hands of voters and voting has begun. In 3 weeks, early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

**Please Consider Donating At Least One Hour Per Week
Sign Waving Or Leaving Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters.

Sign Waving Is Postponed Due To The Expected Rain**
Instead of sign waving, please consider calling voters and leaving Jeff Warner's pre-recorded message to voters.
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Final Donations**
We are excited and humbled to report that the campaign is just under $53,000 in total donations! Thank You So Much! At $36,000, the campaign became the second highest District 4 Republican campaign in the last 35 years! For such a challenging District, we are in awe at the outpouring of support.
The election is coming up soon! Please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us secure our commitments for print ads, radio ads and texting which all need to be purchased in advance. Your donation will help us secure our media commitments.
Consider, $100, buys:
* 1 Radio Ad
* 5 Large Signs
* 20,000 texts

How many can you help us purchase?
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Yard Signs**
We want to begin having yard signs pop-up throughout the District especially for those who live on or near busy roadways.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 5 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=49c18a23bc&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

Friend – I’ll keep this short:
With 39 days to go until the election, experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ have just confirmed what we've already known: **Senate control will once again come down to our race in Georgia.**

That's why Donald Trump has visited our state multiple times to rally the GOP base for my opponent, Herschel Walker – and why Mitch McConnell's super PAC is spending millions to smear me with attack ads.
**With recent polls showing me 2 points down, we need to fight back ASAP or we could lose this seat and our Senate majority. But since I don't take a cent from corporate PACs, I'm fully counting on your grassroots support to power our movement to victory.**
**[So please, friend, will you rush $5 – or as much as you can spare before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline – to help me defeat Herschel Walker, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51701724/370153487/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4153-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTQzNjg2Ny0xNjQxLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3j7zR4GPcK_6NQlL1a86zMwgiNVUff42h4KrDHfmcpE=)**
